text:
Morphy's Opera House finish: White to move and mate in 2

Black's king on e8 is pinned down by the d1 rook and g5 bishop.

Find the queen sacrifice that forces mate ♟️

#Chess #SpeedChess #ChessTactics

creative.headline:
OPERA MATE
*DEFLECTION SAC*
creative.subhead: White to move • Forced Mate in 2
creative.footer: Answer with reactions or in replies.

docked_reply.text:
Solution: 1. Qb8+! Nxb8 2. Rd8# (The Opera Mate).
The queen deflection drags the b8 knight away from defending d8.

https://web3chess.online/academy
